meta.description: THE ONE TRIGGER (2026-09-04): fired by the HRIS close-out route (POST /api/payment-dispatches/cycle-closeout) the moment Payment Dispatch → Stop processing → Close the pay cycle files a FRESH close-out record. The 100%-strip trigger was removed after two false firings. The HRIS claims per-cycle markers before calling, so a week never lands here twice; a reopened-then-re-closed week arrives with celebrate:false and gets a plain close-out-files email. Payload: { celebrate, cycle, stats (paid/total/unpaid), recipients, attachments[CSV,XLSX,PDF as base64], attachments_error, test }. Build Celebration Emails turns base64 into binaries (file0..file2) and words the email HONESTLY from stats.unpaid_count — 100% PAID only when nobody is owed. Has files? routes to the Gmail node with attachments or the one without. Import, attach a Gmail OAuth2 credential to BOTH Gmail nodes, activate, then paste the production webhook URL into Admin → Webhooks under slug payment_cycle_complete. Recipients + extra payload keys are edited in Admin → Webhooks → Open automation; Send test run there mails the admin only.
